backlog.spec: Wrap WARMUP_RATIO = 0.0 in a new block setting warmup_steps fraction to 0.1 while keeping warmdown proportion unchanged to allow more stable convergence on small GPT before decay.

backlog.spec: Replace WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.2 with 0.5 in Muon's parameter update logic to increase regularization strength and reduce variance, which can lower val_bpb.
backlog.title: Empowered Weight Decay

backlog.spec: Implement a dynamic learning rate schedule that increases gradient norm scaling during early optimization stages up to 1.0x, then falls off smoothly, to accelerate loss reduction.
backlog.title: Gradient Norm Climbing

backlog.spec: Add mixed precision training support by specifying torch amp settings in the training loop with AMP_STEPS calculation to allow higher batch sizes without overflow.
backlog.title: Mixed Precision Boost

backlog.spec: Replace standard transformer layers with SquareDream layers to improve context handling and reduce overestimation in predictions.
backlog.title: SQDR Model

backlog.spec: Change beta2 adaptation to warmup-based schedule in Adam optimizer to stabilize training and reduce variance in small networks.
backlog.title: Adam W Warmup

backlog.spec: Replace exponential warmup schedule with linear warmup ratio of 0.1 for balanced learning rate ramping.
backlog.title: Linear Warmup

backlog.spec: Replace full attention with sparse attention mechanism to reduce computation overhead and improve training stability on long contexts.
backlog.title: Sparse Attention

backlog.spec: Replace current warmup schedule with a hybrid scheduling strategy that applies cosine annealing for better convergence.
backlog.title: Hybrid Scheduler

backlog.spec: Implement sparse gradient clipping to reduce computational overhead and improve training speed.
backlog.title: Sparse Gradient Clipping

backlog.spec: Maintain an exponential moving average of model parameters for better generalization by reducing noise in the final predictions.
backlog.title: EMA Queue

backlog.spec: Replace AdamW scheduler by AdamK with continuous optimization policy to reduce confidence of small network outputs.
backlog.title: AdamK Schedule

backlog.spec: Introduce distributed training across multiple GPUs to increase total batch size and improve training efficiency.
backlog.title: Distributed Training

backlog.spec: Replace transformer with HEUR model architecture to reduce overestimation.
backlog.title: HEUR Model

backlog.spec: Change AdamW epsilon from small value to larger value for smoother convergence.
backlog.title: AdamW Epsilon

backlog.spec: Replace exponential warmup with cosine annealing warmup for better convergence.
backlog.title: Warmup Cosine

backlog.spec: Replace standard attention with FOCUS attention mechanism to improve attention distribution and reduce noise.
backlog.title: FOCUS Attention

backlog.spec: Modify optimizer parameters to include additional regularization terms for better convergence.
backlog.title: Amygdala Optimization

backlog.spec: Replace transformer with HYRIS model structure to improve accuracy and reduce overestimation.
backlog.title: HYRIS Model

backlog.spec: Change AdamW eta parameter to reduce noise in gradient updates for smoother convergence.
backlog.title: AdamW Eta

backlog.spec: Replace cosine warmup with exponential warmup for more gradual learning rate adjustment.
backlog.title: Warmup Exponential

backlog.spec: Replace standard attention with NOGA mechanism to reduce overestimation in predictions.
backlog.title: NOGA Attention

backlog.spec: Modify scheduler parameters to include additional regularization terms to improve convergence.
backlog.title: Hydra Scheduler

backlog.spec: Replace exponential warmup with linear warmup for more gradual learning rate adjustment.
backlog.title: Warmup Linear

backlog.spec: Replace ReLU activation with GELU for better performance in small networks that can reduce overestimation.
backlog.title: GELU Integration

backlog.spec: Replace linear warmup with diagonal warmup for more gradual learning rate adjustment.
backlog.title: Warmup Diagonal

backlog.spec: Replace standard embeddings with bounded embedding technique to improve accuracy and reduce overestimation.
backlog.title: बाउंडअर Embedding

backlog.spec: Add a third-order chain regularization term to the Muon weight update loop to penalize rapid changes in the V-chain matrices, similar to the existing Cauchy regularization but applied to V-matrices to stabilize early iterations.
backlog.title: Redundant V-Chain Regularization

backlog.spec: Apply a diagonal attention mask in the evaluation loop that masks the top 20% of diagonal attention weights, reducing redundancy without significantly harming model performance.
backlog.title: Asymmetric Loss Masking

backlog.spec: Add a penalty term to the loss function that penalizes high gradient cross-entropy between consecutive layer outputs, encouraging smoother feature transitions.
backlog.title: Gradient Cross-Entropy Penalty

backlog.spec: Add regularization to the attention scores that penalizes the deviation from softmax complementarity, encouraging more balanced attention distributions.
backlog.title: Softmax Complement Regularization

backlog.spec: Replace the static learning rate schedule with a per-parameter adaptive gradient scaling factor based on the norm of the gradient over the last batch.
backlog.title: Adaptive Gradient Scaling

backlog.spec: Apply a layer-wise normalization on the attention scores before the softmax operation, scaling each layer's attention weights to have unit variance.
backlog.title: Layer-wise Normalization of Attention

backlog.spec: Implement a token-specific dropout mechanism in the attention layer that drops attention weights for tokens below a certain threshold computed on the first batch.
backlog.title: Attention Dropout on Low-Value Tokens

backlog.spec: Add a penalty term to the loss function that encourages interactions between consecutive Bi-Lo layers to be more uniform.
backlog.title: Bi-Layer Interaction Penalty

backlog.spec: Apply a subspace projection before the attention softmax to enforce a constraint on the attention mask, reducing the attention space to a subset of the original.
backlog.title: Attention Mask with Subspace Projections

backlog.spec: Implement a custom gradient normalization scheme that scales gradients based on the top 10% of gradient norms within a window of recent steps.
backlog.title: Custom Gradient Normalization

backlog.spec: Modify the optimizer loop to scale the learning rate by a layer-specific buffer (initialized to 1.0, updated by the norm of the gradient during the step) rather than applying a global LR. This adds a small overhead per update but can stabilize unstable layers.
backlog.title: Layer-wise Learning Rate Buffering

backlog.spec: Cast the input embeddings and queries to bfloat16 before applying RMSNorm and attention, even while keeping weights in bf16. This reduces the dynamic range seen by the attention mechanism, potentially sharpening gradients.
backlog.title: Quantized-Input Attention

backlog.spec: For every ff layer, keep a small ratio (e.g., 4%) of tokens routed to a dense expander, but force the selected tokens to attend to the expander's output in the next attention call, creating a temporary 'expert' view that propagates before mixing.
backlog.title: MoE-Spoken Layer Mixer

backlog.spec: Replace the global weight decay on Muon parameters with a gating-style decay: only decay parameters that have a non-zero gradient component in the current step, scaled by a small factor (e.g., 0.1x) to preserve low-frequency information.
backlog.title: Gating-Weight Decay

backlog.spec: Accumulate gradients over 2 steps before performing the optimizer step, using the batch size computed per step (TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE / 2). This allows a more stable optimizer step with the same wall-clock budget.
backlog.title: Multi-Step Gradient Accumulation

backlog.spec: After computing the attention scores, apply a ReLU gate on the scores themselves (not the logits) and pass this gated attention to FF. This forces the model to attend only to the high-confidence tokens of the current step.
backlog.title: Attention Gating with ReLU Mask

backlog.spec: Replace the linear warmup of the LR with a one-time jump to a high LR (e.g., 1.0x) at step 0, then immediately drop to the baseline schedule. This gives a strong initial push without the long warmup burden.
backlog.title: Jumpstart gradients with a one-shot warmup

backlog.spec: Apply gradient clipping only to the top 5% of largest gradient magnitudes per layer, letting the rest be raw. This focuses training resources on the most influential neurons.
backlog.title: Sparsified Gradient Clipping

backlog.spec: Introduce a static key tensor (from a global parameter) for the first attention layer of each transformer block. The model will attend to this static key with the same considerable learnability of a key but without the overhead of learning it.
backlog.title: Cross-Attention to a Static Key

backlog.spec: Compute the global gradient norm at the start of each step, and scale the learning rate by the inverse of that norm (capped at 1.0) before updating. This ensures the effective learning rate remains constant regardless of gradient magnitude.
backlog.title: Adaptive Gradient Norm
